summary.zh: 桌面分组、文件磁贴与 AI 收纳的公开测试版。
summary.en: Public test of desktop groups, file tiles and AI organization.

description.zh: 将桌面文件分组并以磁贴展示，提供 AI 收纳、桌面体检与外观设置。公开测试版，建议先在非关键桌面测试。Pulse 1.0.60 支持基础桌面功能；工作台、托盘、搜索与 Shell 菜单增强依赖更新的主程序，旧版会降级。
description.en: Groups desktop files and displays tiles, with AI organization, health checks and appearance settings. Public test. Pulse 1.0.60 supports core desktop features; workbench, tray, search and Shell-menu enhancements require a newer host and degrade on older hosts.

notes.zh: 新增文件夹直连映射分组与分组卡片多页翻页（底部圆点与滚轮切换、末页定高）；完善天气/便笺/时钟/照片/应用/暂存区/回收站/磁盘/待办/日历桌面小组件及差异化右键菜单；接入 Pulse 原生 EditHost + LumaText 输入与 Fluent 编辑菜单（修复光标闪烁与中文输入法定位）；优化 Mica/亚克力圆角与雪花噪点质感、主界面标签联动及内存占用。
notes.en: Added folder-mapped group cards and multi-page group pagination (footer dots and wheel switching with constant card height); completed desktop widgets (weather, notes, clock, photos, apps, stash, recycle bin, drive, todo, calendar) with tailored context menus; wired Pulse native EditHost + LumaText input and Fluent edit menus for blinking caret and CJK IME positioning; refined Mica/Acrylic corners, noise grain, tab sync, and memory usage.
notes.tw: 新增資料夾直連映射分組與分組卡片多頁翻頁（底部圓點與滾輪切換、末頁定高）；完善天氣/便箋/時鐘/照片/應用/暫存區/資源回收筒/磁碟/待辦/行事曆桌面小工具及差異化右鍵選單；接入 Pulse 原生 EditHost + LumaText 輸入與 Fluent 編輯選單（修正游標閃爍與中文輸入法定位）；最佳化 Mica/壓克力圓角與雪花噪點質感、主介面分頁聯動及記憶體佔用。

notes.zh: 首个公开测试版：桌面分组、文件磁贴、AI收纳及桌面外观设置。
notes.en: First public test: desktop groups, file tiles, AI organization and desktop appearance settings.
